title: Grateful Dead Live at Bickershaw Festival on 1972-05-07
lineage: Dat -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/
source: SBD -> Master Reel (10 inch - 1/2 track) -> Dat/48k

ai_review.summary: Beautiful soundboard mix captures a top‑tier first set with a fiery Mr. Charlie performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear mix and superb sound quality, indicating a high‑grade soundboard source. Reviewers describe the first set as a “top tier” show—high energy, tight playing despite some tuning delays, and a standout rendition of Mr. Charlie that still excites listeners decades later.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews give 5‑star ratings, highlighting both an excellent recording and a high‑energy, memorable performance; the consensus is overwhelmingly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Beautiful mix and sound quality; clear, balanced audio with no reported dropouts or distortions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as tight and high‑energy despite some tuning delays; overall flow is praised as top‑tier.
